verses.gurmukhi: ਤੀਰਥ ਜਾਤ੍ਰਾ ਸਮੈ ਨ ਏਕਸੈ ਆਵਤ ਸਬੈ ਕਾਹੂ ਸਾਧੂ ਪਾਛੈ ਪਾਪ ਸਬਨ ਕੇ ਜਾਤ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: teerath jaatraa samai na ekasai aavat sabai kaahoo saadhoo paachhai paap saban ke jaat hai ||

en.bdb: All pilgrims on pilgrimage are not alike. But when a rare hermit of higher spiritual state enjoins them, the sins of all of them perish.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਨ੍ਰਿਪ ਸੈਨਾ ਸਮਸਰਿ ਨ ਸਕਲ ਹੋਤ ਏਕ ਏਕ ਪਾਛੇ ਕਈ ਕੋਟਿ ਪਰੇ ਖਾਤ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaise nirap sainaa samasar na sakal hot ek ek paachhe kiee koT pare khaat hai ||

en.bdb: As all soldiers in a king's army are not equally valiant, but together under a brave and courageous general they become a force to reckon with.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਤਉ ਸਮੁੰਦ੍ਰ ਜਲ ਬਿਮਲ ਬੋਹਿਥ ਬਸੈ ਏਕ ਏਕ ਪੈ ਅਨੇਕ ਪਾਰਿ ਪਹੁਚਾਤ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaise tau samu(n)dhr jal bimal bohith basai ek ek pai anek paar pahuchaat hai ||

en.bdb: Just as a ship leads the other ships to the safety of the shore through tumultuous ocean, many passengers of these ship also reach the safety of the other end.

verses.gurmukhi: ਤੈਸੇ ਗੁਰ ਸਿਖ ਸਾਖਾ ਅਨਿਕ ਸੰਸਾਰ ਦੁਆਰ ਸਨਮੁਖ ਓਟ ਗਹੇ ਕੋਟਿ ਬਿਆਸਾਤ ਹੈ ॥੩੬੨॥
verses.translit_en: taise gur sikh saakhaa anik sa(n)saar dhuaar sanamukh oT gahe koT biaasaat hai ||362||

en.bdb: Similarly, there are numerous teachers and disciples at the worldly level, but one who has taken the refuge of the True Guru, an embodiment of the Lord, millions sail across the worldly ocean with his support. (362)
